issues.description: Unsanitized user search input passed directly into RegExp constructor (ReDoS vulnerability)
issues.suggestion: Escape special regex characters using a sanitizeRegex helper before creating RegExp, or use String.prototype.includes().

issues.description: Search filter creates new RegExp instance inside Array.filter callback for every item
issues.suggestion: Compile the regular expression or normalize search query once outside the filter loop.

issues.description: Case sensitivity handling assumes ASCII lowercase, which may fail on multi-byte international characters
issues.suggestion: Use String.prototype.toLocaleLowerCase() or Intl.Collator for robust case-insensitive comparisons.

codeQuality.summary: Search implementation functional but contains a regex denial-of-service risk and per-iteration allocation bottlenecks.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No test case verifying that searching with special regex characters (e.g. *, +, ?, [, ]) does not throw an unhandled exception.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should safely escape regex special characters", () => { expect(() => searchTodos(todos, "test.*[a-z]")).not.toThrow(); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Empty string query branch returning all todos vs empty array is not tested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should return all todos when search query is empty string", () => { expect(searchTodos(todos, "")).toHaveLength(todos.length); });

testCoverage.summary: Core search logic tested for basic keywords, but missing crucial edge cases for regex characters and empty queries.

suggestions.description: Extract search predicate into reusable matcher function
suggestions.before: const matches = todos.filter(t => new RegExp(query, "i").test(t.title) || new RegExp(query, "i").test(t.description));
suggestions.after:
const matcher = createTodoMatcher(query);
const matches = todos.filter(matcher);
suggestions.benefits: Improves performance by compiling matcher once and simplifies unit testing of matching logic in isolation.

suggestions.description: Replace custom trimming and whitespace replacement with standard string trim

refactorings.summary: Extracting match predicate logic will decouple matching strategy from list iteration.

recommendations.description: Sanitize user-provided search queries before constructing regular expressions to prevent Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS).
Add edge-case unit tests covering queries with regex metacharacters, unicode strings, and whitespace queries.
Pre-compile search patterns outside collection iteration loops to avoid redundant allocation during filtering.
